title: Algors Terror Dome Base Camp
description: Algors Terror Dome Base Camp — The Townstons wiki
html:
Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp
Algor's Terror Dome Base Camp is the first outpost. It is reachable by a portal at level 5 Algernon or through a One Way Portal at Sissirat's Lair. There are 2 portals, one leading back to level 5 Algernon and another one leading to Algor's Terror Dome level 1, and also an obelisk. Once you have used the obelisk in Algor's Terror Dome Base Camp it will always be accessible through any obelisk. The name is a parody of conservationist and former vice president Albert Gore.


NPC's

  • Soldier Kwale - He gives multiple quests and does speak a lot.
  • Ex-Soldier Bubba - He gives also multiple quests which are based on Algor's Terror Dome area.
